description:
Polish the video in the editor; changes show in the next export.

scene_note: edit one scene with a note (move, restyle, add or remove
layers and overlays, change the text of a lower third, title card or
callout, change motion); spends credits. Returns the changes and
skipped_mutations: edits that didn't land (applied=false) or landed
differently than asked (applied=true), each with a reason; check them.
Scene lengths follow the narration; the image, clip and voiceover layers
can't be removed. project_note: a note for the whole video, applied to
up to 10 scenes per call; spends credits. captions: merge caption
settings. add_sfx: attach a sound effect to a segment. add_music /
update_music: background music timed in seconds; a track's duration
follows from its trim.

action.description: scene_note: segment_number, message; project_note: message; captions: caption_config; add_sfx: segment_number, library_track_id; add_music: library_track_id, optional name, volume, loop, start_seconds; update_music: track_id and any of name, volume, loop, start_seconds, trim_start_seconds, trim_end_seconds

caption_config.description: captions: keys to merge into the caption settings (get_status shows them)

library_track_id.description: A track id from editor_read action=audio_library

loop.description: Loop the music under the whole video

message.description: The note in plain words, e.g. "move the caption to the top"

start_seconds.description: Where the music starts in the video, in seconds

track_id.description: update_music: a track id from editor_read action=music

trim_end_seconds.description: update_music: where playback stops within the track, in seconds

trim_start_seconds.description: update_music: where playback starts within the track, in seconds

volume.description: Music volume 0-1; the 0.12 default sits under the narration, so raise it only if asked

name: editor_edit
title: Edit the video
